    About Dreamlor

    Gifts made around your story

    Dreamlor is a customised gifting brand in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu. We put together gift boxes, bouquets, hampers, frames and keepsakes for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries and little surprises.

    Tell us who the gift is for and what they love. We use your names, dates and ideas to shape the gift.

    Gifts for every occasionBirthdays, weddings, love and anniversaries, and surprises for kids.
    Personal touchesShare names, dates, photos or colours, and we plan the gift around them.
    Easy to reachMessage us on WhatsApp with the gift you like. We reply with the details.

    FAQ

    Questions, answered

    How do I place an order?

    Tap Enquire on a gift, or message us on WhatsApp at +91 93632 60094. Tell us what you would like and we will guide you from there.

    Can I customise a gift?

    Many of our gifts can be personalised with names, dates, photos or colours. Send us the gift you like and your idea on WhatsApp, and we will confirm what we can do.

    What are the prices?

    The price depends on the gift and how it is customised, so prices are not listed on this page. Tap Enquire on any gift and we will share the price.

    Where are you based?

    Dreamlor is based in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu.

    Do you deliver to my place?

    Please message us with your location and we will tell you the options available for it.

    I need a gift by a certain date. What should I do?

    Include the date in your first message. Time needed depends on the gift, so we will confirm with you.

    Can I ask for a gift that is not on this page?

    Yes, you can ask. Describe your idea on WhatsApp and we will let you know if we can make it.
